body:
New STATE_AI_OPPONENT_BROWSER in apps/lobby/src/main.c ('K' key), fetch_ai_opponent_registry_list + ai_opponent_select_and_load in packages/common/ai_opponent.h, mirroring the level browser's own list/select/dim-if-unusable shape exactly. Fixed a real memory leak (ai_opponent_load_weights re-selection leaked the prior MlpPolicy's buffers). BRAWLPIT commit d71cb80.

⚓ ☃
title: S421-05: real in-game AI opponent browser matching the level registry
